body:
## Purpose

Discovery-only native UI spike after Console Red Team review. This is **not** a Design Freeze and adds no backend capability.

The goal is to stop treating the fixed HTML canvas as production evidence and move one v16 Data Authoring surface into the real Avalonia renderer so layout, Windows font metrics, working-area size, keyboard focus, and minimum-size assumptions can be falsified before any Console Rule Set number becomes normative.

## What this branch does

- extracts effective HTML System Pass/P2 values as **measurement input**, not normative floors
- adds an opt-in Avalonia v16 Data Authoring window (`NODEKIT_UI_SPIKE=v16`)
- keeps normal NodeKit startup unchanged
- gives Activity a shell-level slot and preserves raw `실패 1 · 중단 1` instead of synthesized `확인 필요 2`
- removes the page TOC from the spike so Left owns surface navigation only
- collapses empty post-registration Supporting rows into one explanation
- keeps Center ownership and avoids inventing an enabled/disabled registration CTA as a fake product promise
- uses native OS window chrome rather than HTML pseudo-window glyphs
- records Avalonia Screen Bounds, WorkingArea, Scaling, client size, and renderer scaling in capture diagnostics
- runs Linux/Xvfb logical stress probes and GitHub-hosted Windows renderer probes
- captures keyboard-navigation focus for a Center input and global Activity
- adds `scripts/ui-spike-windows-device-capture.ps1` to make the remaining real-device 125%/150% gate reproducible

## Non-goals

No DataRegisterRequest wiring, Activity drawer behavior, registration action, Rule Set numeric floor, Supporting collapse breakpoint, production navigation change, or Decision 101 synthesized-status mapping.

## Current native findings

See `docs/console-ui/AVALONIA_V16_SPIKE_FINDINGS_V0.1.md`.

### Structure / minimum-size discovery

- `980 × 560` keeps the current four-column structure usable in both Linux layout probes and the hosted Windows Avalonia renderer.
- `900 × 560` is the first clear comfortable-width degradation point: Center becomes cramped, explanatory text wraps aggressively, the page subtitle is compressed, and source URI presentation truncates visibly.
- therefore `980 DIP` remains a **provisional width hypothesis**, not a product minimum.
- `600 DIP` looks conservative as a height hypothesis; `560 DIP` is the next candidate to falsify on real target devices.

### Windows renderer / typography

The hosted Windows runner reports `1024 × 768`, WorkingArea `1024 × 720`, Scaling `1.0`. Korean UI renders correctly there.

- the inherited `9.5` Supporting kicker is visibly smaller than the surrounding hierarchy and must not become a normative R1 floor.
- the next secondary-label candidate should be tested at least at `10.5`.
- 10–11 technical/helper text is readable in the hosted 100% renderer, but this is **not** evidence for the target 125%/150% scaling cases.

### Keyboard focus

Using keyboard-navigation focus semantics at `980 × 600` on the Windows renderer:

- Center TextBox: visible high-contrast blue focus border — PASS
- Activity: visible high-contrast light focus outline — PASS

No custom focus-ring override is justified unless the real 125%/150% device evidence falsifies the native treatment.

## CI evidence

Current head `3e7a49e91cd644e18713d1112ad2fa4874ecd142`:

- Verify: PASS
- Dependency Review: PASS
- CodeQL: PASS
- UI Spike Layout Probe: PASS
- UI Spike Windows Renderer Probe: PASS

The CI renderer artifacts include normal, sub-minimum stress, and keyboard-focus frames. The hosted Windows runner is deliberately treated as native-render evidence at its measured `100%` environment, not as a substitute for target-device DPI evidence.

## Remaining evidence before this spike can inform product rules

Actual Windows device captures are still required at:

- `1366 × 768 @ 125%`
- `1920 × 1080 @ 150%`

For each case record actual Screen Bounds / WorkingArea / Scaling and inspect:

- startup layout
- `980 × 560` height candidate
- Center section 04 reachability
- keyboard focus on a Center input
- keyboard focus on Activity

Use:

```powershell
./scripts/ui-spike-windows-device-capture.ps1 -Case 1366x768-125
./scripts/ui-spike-windows-device-capture.ps1 -Case 1920x1080-150
```

Do **not** promote R1 typography floors, `MinWidth`, `MinHeight`, or adaptive breakpoints until that device evidence exists. Keep this PR draft until then.
title: spike(ui): move v16 authoring layout into Avalonia
